narrative: Commuters crossing the plaza, normal foot traffic, no incidents.
A subject in a dark hoodie lingers near the ATM, repeatedly looking over their shoulder, hands in pockets, for the full duration. No transaction occurs.
Two subjects approach a glass storefront. One pries at the door frame with a crowbar while the other watches the street. Glass cracks audibly.
A subject draws a handgun at the register counter. Clerk raises hands. Subject gestures with the firearm.
A subject loiters by a back door, then begins working at the lock with a screwdriver.
Routine vehicle movements in a parking lot. Drivers park and walk away.
A subject tailgates an authorized employee through the turnstile and immediately diverts down a side corridor.
A figure briefly appears at the edge of the frame, mostly in shadow, holding an indistinct elongated object.
